QuestInfo.name: The King Sage Cat's Questions
QuestInfo.1: The King Sage Cat tricked you into poisoning Do Gong. Time to go back and confront him.
QuestInfo.2: The King Sage Cat offered to give you an #bantidote marble#k if you managed to answer all three of his riddles... but the answers were nowhere to be found. He never meant to give you the antidote at all. For now, go check on Do Gong.

0.0: Ugh... I should have told you more about the King Sage Cat. About how good he is at breaking trust and turning people against each other... That's what makes him dangerous, even more than his magic...\r\n#L0# #b Oh, no...
0.1: This is no ordinary poison. It's magical. In fact, it only works on someone who's actively counterspelling the King Sage Cat. Ugh, he must have planned this from the start... I thought he might try something, so I bulked up my defenses first, but I don't know how much longer I can last...\r\n#L0# #b I'll find an antidote!
0.2: W-will you do that for me? I would assume that the maker of this poison would have its antidote... Augh...! Please go back to the King Sage Cat...!\r\n#b(You will be moved to the King Sage Cat's Forest if you accept.)#k

no.0: We don't have much time...\r\nPlease come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Oh ho, let's give a warm welcome to the traveler fully responsible for helping the King Sage Cat make a giant leap towards his ultimate goal! Ho ho ho ho... How's my friend Do Gong doing? Well, of course, he should be bedridden by now from that devastating poison... ho ho ho ho! \r\n#L0##bGive me the antidote now!
1.1: No no no. Aren't you supposed to question anything you receive from a stranger? But I tell you what, I will give you ONE chance, ONE chance to receive the Antidote Crystal. Of course, if you refuse this opportunity, then it's over. \r\n#L0# #b ...opportunity?
1.2: Yes! I will give you THREE questions. If you can answer all three, then I will hand you the antidote crystal, the real deal that can neutralize the red crystal. What do you think? Are you ready to answer the questions?\r\n#L0# #bYeah, I am! #l \r\n#L1# #bNo way!#l
1.3: Okay, here's the first question... Mu Lung is a place where Masters train, but seriously, is there a Master as great as the King Sage Cat? \r\n#L0# #b Yes #l \r\n#L1# #b ...... #l
1.4: Here's the second question. Back in the day, there was a foolish student here at Mu Lung who thought, if he could wield his strength, he will be able to defeat the Sage Cats and bring 'peace' to Mu Lung. Now, those Sage Cats were the disciples of me, the King Sage Cats. Rather than being totally unnerved by his actions, the King Sage Cat, mercifully, awarded him with a spell that soothes and uncomplicates his mind. Is this 'punishment' feasible?  \r\n#L0# #b No, it isn't. #l \r\n#L1# #b ...#l
1.5: Here's the last question! Even someone as pure and honest as King Sage Cat wants to have fun sometimes. Do you think he meant it when he said he'll give you the antidote crystal for correctly answering all three questions?\r\n#L0# #bYes, he did. #l \r\n#L1# #bNo way...#l
1.6: Of course, I meant it! If you had answered the questions correctly, the crystal would have been yours. But I'm sorry to say you didn't!

yes.0: Wrong, wrong, and wrong again! I thought you'd have no problem giving a silly answer to a silly question! There's no way I can give you the antidote now!

2.1: Hah, if you are like this, then I sure can't give you the antidote crystal. Is that all the guilt you have on Do Gong? That's it?

3.0: Hahaha! You didn't mean that, did you? If you were, then there's no point of giving Do Gong, who isn't even a real Master, an antidote!

4.0: Of course! Of course! In that regard, the item I gave to Do Gong is also a medicine of sort, so I shouldn't bother giving you an antidote crystal!

5.0: Wrong! I didn't mean it! I was FINALLY able to put Do Gong in a tough spot, so WHY should I help him out now? Even if you answered them all correct, I would never give you the antidote! Never!

npc.0: Ahhh... only the King Sage Cat has the antidote...
